_readme: Copy to e1/pdfs.json (gitignored). Replace all three examples with distinct real PDFs and actual SHA-256 values. Relative PDF paths resolve beside the manifest. Each inclusive physical-page window must contain 1-15 pages. Preflight: node e1/run-e1.mjs --real --check --manifest e1/pdfs.json. Hash in PowerShell: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <file>.
